subject: Meridian Health — Azure Marketplace entitlement & billing redlines
messages:
From: Alyssa Greene <alyssa.greene@meridianhealth.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood-inference.com
Cc: Procurement Team <procure@meridianhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: FW: Marketplace listing / entitlement questions (Meridian Health)

Hi Neha,

Thanks for the call last week. Attaching our standard procurement redlines to the MSA and a short list of questions so your legal/commercial teams can review:

- We need confirmation that entitlements will be issued from the Azure Private Offer path (not direct-invoice). Can you confirm the invoice routing and whether Azure will invoice Meridian directly or if Redwood will?
- Data residency: all PHI-related logs must remain in US regions and be subject to our retention policy (7 years). Can you confirm retention and log access?
- Audit evidence: Meridian requires SOC 2 Type II evidence and 12 months of access to operational logs for audit.
- Pricing/credits: we expect a one-time onboarding credit and an initial three-month consumption cap tied to the pilot.

Attached: Meridian_MSA_redline.pdf (pdf)

We are targeting procurement sign-off by 9/1; would appreciate an initial redline from your side this week.

Thanks,
Alyssa Greene
Senior Procurement Manager
Meridian Health

From: neha_kapoor@redwood-inference.com
To: Alyssa Greene <alyssa.greene@meridianhealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood-inference.com, laura_bennett@redwood-inference.com
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FW: Marketplace listing / entitlement questions (Meridian Health)

Hi Alyssa — thanks for sending this over and the clear timeline. Looping in Ben (commercials) and Laura (legal) to get us moving. Quick answers up top and then a proposed next step: 

- Entitlements: We support Azure Private Offers; default flow is that Azure issues the entitlement and invoices Meridian, with Redwood receiving marketplace payout per the marketplace revenue schedule. We can also accommodate a routed-invoice model in specified regions if required — Ben will propose options.
- Data residency & logs: Redwood Private + VNet deployment for Meridian would keep logs in the customer region (US East). We can commit to retention configuration, and provide a scoped log-export for audits. Laura, will need to confirm exact DPA language.
- SOC2 evidence: we have SOC 2 Type II report available for review under NDA; we can provide 12 months of operational logs via a secure export for audit windows.
- Credits: we can offer a one-time onboarding credit; Ben will propose the amount and whether it comes as discount or marketplace credit.

Next step: Ben and I propose a 30-min call Monday 8/24 10am PT to walk the procurement team through billing flows (diagram attached) and go over the redlines line-by-line. If that works I'll send a calendar invite. 

Attached: RI_commercial_term_sheet_v1.xlsx, billing_flow_diagram.png

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Head of Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: ben_carter@redwood-inference.com
To: neha_kapoor@redwood-inference.com, laura_bennett@redwood-inference.com
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Meridian - proposed billing and entitlement options

Team — drafting proposed options for the call. Key variants:

Option A (Marketplace native):
- Entitlements: Azure issues entitlements via Private Offer manifest; Meridian is invoiced by Microsoft.
- Redwood receives payout per Azure settlement (net 45–60 days).
- Pros: easiest for procurement; Microsoft handles invoicing and tax.
- Cons: cash flow delay and lower immediate cash; needs clear marketplace SKUs and meter mapping.

Option B (Routed invoicing via Redwood):
- Entitlements still provisioned through Azure, but Redwood invoices Meridian directly under reseller/partner agreement.
- Pros: faster revenue recognition for Redwood, more flexible crediting.
- Cons: needs additional marketplace/App registration and approval; Meridian procurement may require additional PO fields.

Commercial asks for Meridian pilot: one-time onboarding credit = $25k (applied as a marketplace discount if Option A, or as an invoice credit if Option B). Initial three-month consumption cap of $80k. If Meridian commits to a 12-month minimum consumption (annualized run-rate), we can offer a 10% uplift on any overage credits.

I attached a simple term sheet and a billing_flow_diagram.png for the call. Laura, please flag any legal blockers on the routed-invoice path; procurement will push back on anything that changes the invoicing entity.

Attachments: RI_commercial_term_sheet_v1.xlsx

— Ben
Director, Marketplaces & Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Alyssa Greene <alyssa.greene@meridianhealth.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood-inference.com
Cc: Victor Ramos <victor.ramos@meridianhealth.com>, Procurement Team <procure@meridianhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 10:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FW: Marketplace listing / entitlement questions (Meridian Health)

Neha / Ben — thanks for the detailed options, that helps. A few clarifications from procurement and legal: 

- Marketplace native (Option A) preferred by Meridian for tax and vendor tracking, but cashflow delay is real — procurement wants to see the exact Azure SKU mapping before committing. Can you send the SKU-level mapping and estimated monthly metering forecast for the pilot?
- Data residency: Meridian cannot accept logs exported outside US regions. The DPA redline includes a hard residency clause. We are okay with scoped log exports for audits but the primary storage must be US.
- SOC2: we will sign an NDA to receive the report. Please send instructions for secure access.
- Routed invoicing (Option B) is acceptable if Redwood can provide invoice templates and a PO field mapping doc. Procurement also needs a sample invoice and bank remit details for Redwood.

Attached are in-line comments to the MSA redline (see Meridian_MSA_redline.pdf). I also pasted below the procurement timeline: 8/24 — call (please confirm), 8/27 — Meridian review and internal approvals, 9/1 — target signature.

From: laura_bennett@redwood-inference.com
To: Alyssa Greene <alyssa.greene@meridianhealth.com>, neha_kapoor@redwood-inference.com, ben_carter@redwood-inference.com
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Meridian Health — Azure Marketplace entitlement & billing redlines

Alyssa / Victor / Procurement — thank you for the comments and the timeline. Quick summary and requested confirmations so procurement can move to PO: 

1) Entitlements & invoicing: We will proceed with Option A (Marketplace native) as Meridian prefers that path. Redwood will provide SKU-level mapping and estimated metering for the pilot by EOD 8/26. Azure will invoice Meridian; Redwood will provide settlement schedule and expected payout timing.

2) Data residency & logs: Redwood confirms primary storage and log retention will be in US East for Meridian-related tenant/data. The DPA will be updated to reflect a US-only residency clause and 7-year retention for PHI-related audit logs. Laura to follow with exact DPA language and a short addendum for operational log export procedures.

3) SOC2 access: We will execute the NDA (link below) and provide secure access to the SOC2 Type II report within 48 hours of NDA execution.

4) Credits & commercials: Redwood confirms $25k onboarding credit to be applied as a marketplace discount under Option A; initial consumption cap of $80k for the pilot. If Meridian signs a 12-month commitment, we will provide a 10% rebate on annualized consumption overages. Final commercial term sheet attached.

Next steps (action items):
- Neha/Ben: share SKU mapping + metering forecast by 8/26.
- Laura: send DPA redline and NDA link by EOD 8/26.
- Alyssa/Procurement: confirm PO issuance date target and whether routed-invoice option needs a sample invoice.

Attachments: RI_commercial_term_sheet_v1.xlsx, Meridian_MSA_redline_final_draft.pdf

If the above matches Meridian's expectations we'll target signature by 9/1 per your timeline.

Best regards,
Laura Bennett
Head of Legal
Redwood Inference
